spans.s: To be languid or weary, be exhausted.
वै [vai], ind. A particle of affirmation or certainty (indeed, truly, forsooth), but it is generally used as an expletive; आपो वै नरसूनवः
;2.231;9.49; 11.78 &c. It is also said to be a vocative particle, and sometimes shows entreaty or persuasion (अनुनय).
